summary: National Beverage Corp. filed an 8-K on July 2, 2026, reporting fiscal year 2026 results and announcing a special cash dividend of $3.25 per share. The special dividend is payable on July 30, 2026 to shareholders of record on July 13, 2026. This marks the thirteenth such payment in 22 years, distributing $19.78 per share cumulative, or over $1.8 billion. The board declared the dividend without naming any financial advisor. The company is returning capital to shareholders rather than pursuing a strategic transaction; no structural mechanics, regulatory clocks, or risk arbitrage angles apply.
